reviews.text: Been bringing my little kitten Boba here for his vaccinations. The staff are lovely and his vet Alan is amazing with him and the prices are gd to for anyone looking for a vet thats not overly priced. Would highly recommend this practice for ur fur baby's.
Michael and his team have been my pets Vet for the last 15 years. They are always so helpful and knowledgeable, I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere else

Fab vet clinic. Very attentive, no nonsence approach, totally trustworthy.
The vet is brave enough to tackle my ferocious cat without the need to put her in crush cage, so kudos to him!
Fully recommended.

My cat Astrid has been coming here for a while now and my sisters dog Zuma. The care and attention that hsve been given to our animals has been second to none from Michael and Alan and staff are so friendly. Always kind and always giving advice on how best to care for our animals.  I was paying hundreds before I come here from.a  previous vet, as my cat Astrid was poorly, and they didn't know the cause. Michael got Asfrid back on track, and she's doing amazing, as well as the knowledge and advice since we've been here from him and also Alan. I know Astrid and Zuma are in safe hands.

Our Pygmy hedgehog needed a surgery due to a lump on her body, they organised it quickly and she was in and out on the same day! Since the surgery, she’s been full of life and cuddlier than ever ❤️ we are so thankful and happy with the vet, the nurse and the reception staff for all their help! The vet did an amazing job with the surgery and she is healing so well, couldn’t be happier.
Just phoned Ardmory Clinic and they were very helpful, first impressions very good and feel more at ease with regard to dog having issues, Thanks Ardmory Clinic

Hi been coming here for 8 years now with my two cats, my two boys are always put at ease it's a friendly and welcoming clinic can't thank the team enough for their help over the years , take a bow Team Ardmory 👏👏👏👏 …

I wanted to leave a review as I've read the negative reviews about this practice and think a few things need clarified.

First of all, the comments about needing to wait outside: I can imagine this was during covid and that they followed the government installed restrictions on access to confined space, meaning people to wait outside during appointments, as the number of staff in the building meant the floorspace was at capacity.
This is not the case now.

I've seen another comment saying that it's a little bit expensive: I have a tortoise. To be able to find somebody who actually knows what they are talking about - to provide, informed, knowledgeable, experienced care for a reptile - is rare and expensive. I came home the other day and asked my husband to guess how much it cost to have a blood sample, poo sample, full examination and 30 minute consultation done for Sheldon. He guessed £160, which would have been my ballpark, too. It was £90. If you consider this expensive, you have not done the adequate research that should be done before taking on the responsibility of another creature's life.

The service that we have received has been exemplary, thorough and affordable. I cannot fault it.
Don't understand why this vet doesn't take on new clients,I have been trying for over 7 years to get on their books with various animals.

Another update:2025
They NEVER respond to online enquiries, no matter what is it about! Also a person at reception not approachable, seems that she doesn't care about customers and their pets. They used to have an email address displayed on the website, now it is all online on call but no one helpful to handle customer enquiries. 5 years after covid and still unable to go for a check in with my pets, have to wait outside the room, which is putting animals at extra stress. All other vets allow pet owners to be in with then during the check up. Very strange practice.

Update.
4 yrs after covid and still cannot go in if someone else is. Doesn't matter if it rains. Also pet goes for the check up without owner being allowed, as someone mentioned below - hidden checks. Immediately losing a trust and relationship with the vets. I have other pets register in other practices and never had to wait outside and ALWAYS allowed with my pet in. I wish Ardmory looked at the feedback and implemented some pet owner friednly environment. Staff usually nice but if calling to make an urgent appointment they are nit too happy.

I wish they allowed the owner in with the pet for the check up like other vets do, to build the trust and at the same time make the pet and owner less stressed, and save time on visit as vet could ask the owner any questions whilst checking over their pet, meaning less waiting time for another furry patient.. taking the pet in to the check up room and not allowing owner in leaves so many unanswered questions and puts unnecessary pressure on someone who may be worried about their furry baby.
Staff are nice, but the above should be considered for a 'good animal-centred care' ...
